name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
steps: Stand or sit tall with your palms together in front of your chest and your elbows pointing out.
Press your palms firmly together until you feel tension across your chest.
Hold the pressure steady as you breathe.
Release the squeeze smoothly and lower your arms to finish.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed down away from your ears so your chest rather than your upper traps does the work.
Avoid holding your breath while maintaining the isometric contraction.
